title: not routine
name: Not routine — NN/g
rule: Do not use confirmation dialogs for routine actions, or people will stop reading them.
pass_when: Routine actions proceed with no confirmation dialog.
overview: Confirmation dialogs stay off routine actions so people keep reading them.
apply_when: Deciding whether a frequent low-risk action needs a confirm.
not_when: Serious or irreversible actions that still need confirm or undo.
agent_hint: Skip confirmation dialogs on routine actions; reserve them for real risk.
description: Confirmation dialogs lose power when they appear on routine work—people stop reading and click through habitually. Let ordinary frequent actions proceed without a confirm so real confirms still get attention. Keep confirms, or an undo window, for serious consequences where interruption earns its cost. The goal is scarce, meaningful interruption, not a confirm on every save, toggle, or navigation.
